companyFieldUpdates.name: Avolta Renewable Holdings
companyFieldUpdates.description: Avolta Renewable Holdings, LLC is a U.S. renewable-natural-gas platform formed as a joint venture between Energy Capital Partners and Avolta, LLC in February 2022. Operating through the Avolta Development brand, the company develops, finances, owns and operates dairy and landfill RNG projects, including feedstock and site rights, digesters, gas-upgrading equipment, pipeline interconnections, offtake and environmental-credit arrangements. End markets include pipeline gas utilities, transportation-fuel programs and other low-carbon fuel buyers. ECP continues to list the platform as current, and Avolta published current Texas operating activity in May 2026. Exact ownership percentages, governance economics, ECP fund and legal holding vehicle are not publicly disclosed. Avolta, LLC is headquartered in Charleston, West Virginia; Texas, Florida and Arizona are operating or project locations rather than headquarters. No direct sale or signed pending platform exit was identified through August 19, 2026. Avolta Energy, Nacelle and individual project SPVs are not part of this canonical company record.
